items.name: m02/ward_machine_loop
items.title: M02 ward machine loop
items.prompt: Seamless short loop of an enclosed industrial correction machine: low electric motor hum, restrained relay clicks and a steady metal drive. Physical and indifferent, inside a tiled room. Even level across the seam. No voices, music, alarms, siren, combat, skittering or dramatic swell.

items.name: m02/ward_machine_stop
items.title: M02 ward machine stop
items.prompt: One correction machine shutting down: a relay trips, its electric drive winds down and a steel frame settles into silence. Dry mechanical stop with a short natural decay. No explosion, voices, music, success chime or prolonged ambience.

items.name: m02/restraint_release
items.title: M02 restraint release
items.prompt: One industrial restraint opening: a heavy steel latch retracts, two tight ratchet clicks and the hinged restraint arm swings free. Close, dry and physical. No voice, scream, music, chime or victory sound.

items.name: m02/floor_machinery_loop
items.title: M02 processing-floor machinery loop
items.prompt: Seamless short loop of a separate working industrial processing floor: distant conveyor rollers, low electric motors and a sparse structural creak in a broad room. Quiet texture beneath speech and combat, distinct from the stopped ward machine. No voices, music, alarms, weapon sounds or creature skitter.
